<!-- Generated by Bernard the taktician. Do not edit: change .factory/ and run `bernard sync`. -->

Split the feature into tickets for the `implement` step, inspired by the input plan.

Read the migration plan and the PRD in `docs/features/<feature>/`.

A feature is one ticket by default. Split only where a part cannot ship in the same ticket: it goes through another graph, a later part needs it merged first, or one `implement` session cannot hold both. The same change repeated across modules is one ticket, and the docs, ADRs and demo a change needs ship in its ticket.

Write each to `docs/features/<feature>/tickets/<NN>-<slug>.md`, in delivery order: its goal, scope, acceptance criteria each checkable by a test, the legacy behaviour it keeps, and what it leaves out. Commit them alone (`docs(<feature>): split the feature into tickets`) and push.
